tagline: Timeless Italian Taste, Right Here in Danville
description: Incontro Ristorante is an upscale-casual Italian restaurant in the historic Hartz House at 455 Hartz Ave in downtown Danville, serving regional Italian cooking across a garden patio, a covered veranda and stone-walled indoor dining rooms. The restaurant's own words: "Incontro is a place where family and friends come together to share meaningful moments. Inspired by the rich culinary heritage of Italy, our name reflects the spirit of gathering and connection. We bring diverse flavors from all regions of Italy to the heart of Danville." (incontrodanville.com). Bread, pasta and desserts are made in house; the kitchen runs handmade gnocchi, lasagne, lobster ravioli, a four-pasta "Chef's Taste of Italy" plate, plus seafood and steak secondi. There is an indoor and outdoor full bar, live music on the patio in the warmer months, a Sunday all-you-can-eat brunch buffet plus a Saturday midday buffet, a 16-seat Wine Room for private dining and a full tray catering menu. Albi's Middle Eastern Beer Garden, run by the owners' daughter Monique Moufarrej, occupies the back of the same 455 Hartz Ave property.
cuisine: Italian (regional Italian; also listed as Italian/American on Tripadvisor)

owner_chef: Owned by the Moufarrej family — Gabe Moufarrej is identified as the owner (ABC7 News, Dec 31 2020) and Bernadette Moufarrej as manager; their daughter Monique Moufarrej (Culinary Institute of America; Del Posto, Rich Table, Angler SF) opened sister restaurant Albi's at the back of the same property in April 2026 and is described as having "grew up in Danville and her parents owned Incontro Ristorante" (Danville Patch). When Incontro relocated to Danville in 2011 the co-owners were Gianni Bartoletti and Stefano Giovacchini and the executive chef was Raul Aguirre (napasonomamagazine.com Weekly Dish, May 2 2011). No current executive-chef name is published on any page I could read.
opened: 2011 at 455 Hartz Ave, Danville. Incontro relocated from San Ramon into the former La Ultima space at 455 Hartz Avenue; the owners were targeting an August 2011 opening (napasonomamagazine.com "Weekly Dish: Incontro Moving to Danville", May 2 2011). ABC7 News (Dec 31 2020) described the restaurant as having been at the Danville location for roughly 10 years, consistent with a 2011 opening.

brand_colors_or_style: Deep-navy-and-gold, classic-serif Italian. The site's Elementor global palette is: primary #E6C9A2 (champagne gold), secondary #0E1927 (near-black navy), text #080F19, accent #C8C8C8, with cream #FBF5EE and a warm tan #DAB98D as secondary tints. Type pairs Cormorant Infant (serif display, used for headings and the wordmark) with DM Sans for body copy. The logo is a horizontal cream-on-charcoal wordmark reading INCONTRO / RISTORANTE in an all-caps serif; the physical signage uses the same wordmark in gold on dark (visible on the exterior sign and the interior bar-wall sign). Promotional flyers follow the same navy-and-gold, thin-gold-rule, Art-Deco-ish frame treatment. Physical look: exposed stone and warm plaster interiors, gold/white linens, a covered wooden veranda strung with Edison lights, a granite bar top, patio fire pits and greenery.

notes:
NAME AND ADDRESS CONFIRMED. The exact name is "Incontro Ristorante" (the OpenTable listing shortens it to "Incontro Restaurant"). The address is 455 Hartz Ave, Danville, CA 94526 — NOT the Church St corner. It sits on the west side of Hartz between Church St and Railroad Ave, in the building OpenStreetMap independently names "Hartz House," which matches the restaurant's own claim of dining "in the historic Hartz House." Nearby-business check from the vrconcierge listing: Danville Harvest at 500 Hartz Ave (210 ft), Cocina Hermanas at 501 Hartz Ave (220 ft) and Bridges Restaurant & Bar at 44 Church St (229 ft). Note the brief's premise about "Rancho Cantina at 501 Hartz" — 501 Hartz is now listed as Cocina Hermanas. I did not verify Kaia's Island Kitchen at 480 Hartz.

SISTER RESTAURANT: Albi's Middle Eastern Beer Garden occupies the back of the same 455 Hartz Ave property, opened April 24 2026, run by Monique Moufarrej (daughter of Incontro's owners; CIA graduate, ex-Del Posto, ex-Rich Table, ex-Angler SF). Hours Wed–Sun 11:30 AM–8:00 PM. Site: albisdanville.com, Instagram @albis_danville. Incontro's homepage carries an Albi's promo block and one Albi's food photo (a Middle Eastern mezze spread at https://www.incontrodanville.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/652769770_17927523081239109_227673107610504758_n.jpg) — I excluded it from the images array because it is Albi's food, not Incontro's.

MENU SOURCE: the website's "Menu" and "view all menu" links both point to the boons.io ordering site, which is the live, current menu — the price widget embedded on the homepage is stale (it shows Bruschetta at $24 and $16 where the live menu says $16; vegan pastas at $26 where the live menu says $27). All dish prices I reported come from the live ordering menu.

DATA I COULD NOT GET, and why: (1) OpenTable — both WebFetch and curl timed out repeatedly against opentable.com from this environment, so I have no OpenTable rating, review count, dress code, parking or executive-chef field; the reservation URL comes from the restaurant's own homepage link. (2) Yelp — returns HTTP 403 to both WebFetch and curl. Search-result page titles show "591 Reviews, 626 Photos" as of August 2026 but I could not read the star rating off the page, so yelp_rating is left empty rather than guessed. (3) Instagram — instagram.com/incontro_ristorante returns a JavaScript shell with no bio text in the HTML, so no bio captured. (4) Facebook — facebook.com/INCONTRODANVILLE returned HTTP 400 to curl and only the page title to WebFetch. (5) The homepage has NO og:image meta tag, so og_image is empty. (6) No current executive-chef name is published anywhere I could read. (7) No dedicated private-dining page exists; private events live in a homepage section, so private_dining_url is empty — the Eventective third-party listing (100-guest max, 16-seat Wine Room, events phone 925-548-7778, $500–$5,000/event) is the most detailed source.

OTHER SOCIAL: the restaurant also links X/Twitter @INCONTRO455 (https://x.com/INCONTRO455) from its site footer. No TikTok found. The footer's "Facebook"/"Instagram" icons on some templates point to bare facebook.com / instagram.com placeholders; the real handles are in the header and are the ones I reported.

SITE-QUALITY CAVEAT for anyone re-scraping: the WordPress theme ("Basilico") still has unedited demo content in places — the catering page shows fake sister locations in Sydney, Tokyo and New York with a placeholder phone +(406) 555-0120 and Basilicofood123@gmail.com, and the footer carries a leftover "Andé Restaurant, 767 5th Avenue, Paris" block and lorem ipsum. None of that is real. Likewise, the homepage's lead exterior image is an AI-generated ChatGPT render, flagged in the images array.

EVENTS/PROMOS observed in the site media library (2026): monthly 10%-off online-order promo codes (LABOR10, TREAT10, SUMMER10, TGIF10, SPECIAL10, FREEDOM10, BESTDAD), holiday prix-fixe PDFs (Valentine's, Easter brunch, Mother's Day, Father's Day brunch, Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, Thanksgiving) and a wine-dinner series — e.g. "Incontro Presents O'Neill's Wine Dinner, Thursday March 12, 2026, 6:30 pm, $145 per person plus tax and gratuity," a five-course menu with Robert Hall and Ram's Gate pairings (graphic at https://www.incontrodanville.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/A43BE9B2-052B-4129-9EFD-5F4FFCCED4B5.jpg).

IMAGE METHOD: I pulled raw HTML for the homepage and catering page with curl, extracted img src / srcset / data-src / CSS background-image / og:image, resolved relative URLs and stripped WordPress size suffixes to reach the originals; I then enumerated the full media library via the WordPress REST API (wp-json/wp/v2/media, 116 items across 2 pages) to catch photos not currently placed on a page and to read the alt text. Every URL in the images array was checked with curl -sIL (all returned HTTP 200 with the content-type and content-length recorded) and then downloaded and measured with Pillow for true width/height. Theme demo/stock assets (anything titled "Basilico", plus the unsplash and pexels files) were excluded. No Instagram or Facebook CDN URLs are included, and no Yelp or Google user photos were needed — every image is first-party on incontrodanville.com.
